The Appendix C script and tools/deadline.sh are reproducible; the V15 (generator) sub-evidence was independently verified. The design explicitly does not gate the merge on AC10's full end-to-end run (CLAUDE.md Merges §2); it is one of the 'targeted gates' that runs in the executor's environment.

Three mutants (M6, M7, M8) are silent bypasses when combined with a fault: weakening the bad-check or reintroducing SOURCE_PENDING would let a wrong pair through. The design explicitly considers and accepts this risk (no current wrong pair exists; the bad-check would be stricter than today's filtered check if the mechanism returned). Recommend: a non-D-149 follow-up could add a separate `replay-map-index-fuzz` test that inserts a wrong pair into a temporary copy of the capture and asserts the guard catches it — proves the gate is doing real work even when no wrong pair is committed.

The positive control M4 (commented out) is not a silent bypass because the bad-check is still active; but the positive control is the only line that asserts the scan still SEES the D-149 pair. If a future change moves the index in tools/earth_link_capture.gd (e.g. add a line above), the positive control's expected filename will shift but the test will fail loudly with the shifted list (per the design's Risks bullet). The pair is checked by name. Acceptable.
